sources.name: background
sources.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production game puzzle clean background, full bleed portrait 4:5, detailed warm oil/gouache illustration with visible painterly texture, natural coherent light/perspective. Fully opaque RGB: every pixel alpha255, no transparent areas or edge glitches. No writing, logos, digits, identifiable famous place, frame or UI. Complete inviting scene; omit only specified tiny later animated details, leaving natural anchor surfaces. Wide intimate view from slightly above inside a cozy wooden boat cabin with a round porthole looking at calm sea. SOFT VIOLET dominates broad painted wall boards, linen bunk cushion and folded blanket, brown wood trim and ivory ceramic cup complement. Include a warm filled teacup on narrow table with no steam, one tiny empty brass bud vase beside it, a visible bare hook above bunk, a plain knotted string around small book, and a small clay pot with a bare short plant stem near porthole. Later details steam, flower, hanging violet tassel, string bow, leaf sprig. Natural cabin construction and intimate warmth.

sources.name: atlas
sources.prompt: Create one professional game-art sprite atlas, transparent RGBA background. Canvas 1536x1024 divided invisibly into 3 columns and 2 rows, five separate complete objects centered in cells 0,1,2,3,4 (row major); cell5 entirely empty. Each object must remain entirely INSIDE its own 512x512 cell with at least 55 pixels EMPTY TRANSPARENT margin on all four sides, including stems, shadows, wisps and strings. No outlines, no text, no labels, no ground, no boards, no broad glowing fog; genuine transparency outside the object. High quality softly painted gouache/oil storybook realism, detailed textured brushwork, warm sunlight from upper left, natural colors, no flat vector art. Details will be scaled small and placed into a matching painted puzzle scene. Warm violet-painted wooden boat cabin details. Cell0: one narrow short warm ivory wisp of tea steam, feathered genuine transparent edges, no cup, no broad fog. Cell1: a tiny lavender flower stalk with multiple purple buds and long slim green cut stem, rootless, for a brass vase. Cell2: one short violet cotton tassel with a CLOSED short string loop at its top to hang on a brass hook, complete and bounded. Cell3: one small pale ivory feather lying flat on a closed journal viewed diagonally from above, minimal tight contact shadow only. Cell4: small fresh olive-green leaf pair on a woody cut stem, rootless, for a potted twig.

sources.name: replacement-atlas
sources.prompt: Production game-art RGBA sprite atlas, 1536x1024 pixels, transparent background. Three complete separate objects on top row only, in three invisible 512x512 cells. Bottom row empty transparent. Center each whole object within central300x300 of its own cell, surrounded on every side by wide transparent empty margins. Soft detailed oil/gouache brushwork, warm upper-left light. Cell0: ONE isolated small ivory feather, viewed diagonally from above, fine soft barbs and complete golden quill. Feather alone suspended in transparent space, no surrounding scene or support. Cell1: ONE isolated small warm-gray feather, different shorter rounded shape, fine soft barbs, full cream quill, viewed diagonally from above; feather alone in transparent space. Cell2: five very thin short pale-blue and ivory horizontal shimmering reflection strokes, forming a FLAT CALM elliptical water ripple, all strokes separated by genuine transparent gaps and feathered edges; no breaking waves, no spray, no mound, no solid water surface, no broad haze. No books, no pebbles, no floor, no scenery, no typography, no labels, no diagram lines. True empty alpha outside the three specific objects.

authoring.visualReviewNotes: Original opaque background and complete transparent subjects inspected. Real mouths, hooks, handles, vegetation and ground establish attachments. Custom extraction preserves complete silhouettes and uses empty alpha gutters. Scene115 original feather-on-book and Scene116 feather-on-stones and large splash were rejected and replaced by isolated feathers and calm ripple. Scene117 loose twine rests on clear mat away from existing paper bow. Final composite and renderer review recorded separately. Palette uses median RGB from the specified large colored material; whole-image warm-light hue histogram remains separately recorded.
